title: Replace Engram failed-Stop race polling with synchronization
outcome: The deterministic failed Stop during in-flight begin regression currently polls awaiting_runtime_stop_resolution every 5 ms with a 2 s hang guard. It passes under contention and is not classified as flaky, but a channel/condvar hand-off would remove the final wall-clock loop from the adapter module.
acceptance: The test uses an explicit synchronization hand-off for the deferred-by-Stop transition, retains a bounded hang guard only for deadlock detection, and still proves failed Stop resumes delivery while successful Stop supersedes cleanly.
